Why Celina businesses miss calls

Celina has been one of the fastest-growing cities in the country, so older Census figures understate its size today. It has a median household income of about $171,000, and over a third of workers are in finance, real estate or professional services. New neighborhoods keep builders, landscapers and home services busy, while a small business base means customers often search for providers that are not yet well known.

Which Celina businesses benefit most?

  • Real estate agents: New communities bring buyers at all hours.
  • HVAC and contractors: New builds need ongoing service.
  • Dental offices: New families need a local dentist.

Can you keep your Celina phone number?

Yes. Celina callers will usually see the 214, 469, 972 and 945 area codes, and you can keep the number customers already know. Forward it to the AI for all calls, only after hours, or only when your team does not pick up. We can also set up a new local number. Everything is set up remotely, so you do not need new equipment or a visit to an office.

What to check before you go live

  1. Test real calls: ask awkward questions, not only easy ones, and listen to how it handles them.
  2. Set the rules: decide which calls transfer to a person and which become messages.
  3. Plan your minutes: estimate your busiest month, not an average one.
  4. Tell callers what you need to: Texas is generally treated as a one-party consent state for recording calls, but rules differ for callers in other states, so check with your advisor if you record calls.
